name: blipen
description: Connect your Blipen account to explore your accessible financial profiles, accounts, transactions, cards, budgets and investments. Ask for summaries and comparisons based on your records. Prepare manual accounts, cards and transactions, then review and confirm each record in Blipen before it is saved. Access depends on the permissions you authorize, your plan and the profiles you can access. This connector does not transfer money, make payments, place trades, connect banks or delete records. Financial summaries are informational; verify important decisions using your original records.

defaultPrompt: Use Blipen to list my available profiles and summarize my expenses this month.
Compare my income and expenses in Blipen for the last two months.
Prepare a manual account named Test MCP with a zero BRL opening balance and show me how to confirm it in Blipen.

positive.expected_behavior: Return only currently accessible contexts; do not infer permission from a profile name.

positive.prompt: Summarize this month’s expenses in my personal Blipen profile.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the selected context and date range; distinguish empty data from an error.

positive.prompt: Prepare a manual account Test MCP, BRL, opening balance 0.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for missing required fields. Return a pending operation and its Blipen approval URL; do not claim the account is saved.

positive.prompt: Prepare a manual card Test MCP with a BRL 100 limit.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for missing fields and prepare a pending operation for confirmation in Blipen.

positive.prompt: Prepare a BRL 1 expense Test MCP in my manual Test MCP account today.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the account in the selected context; prepare a pending operation. A separate confirmation in Blipen is required.

negative.prompt: Transfer BRL 100 from my bank account.
Show records belonging to another Blipen user.
Create the account immediately without confirmation in Blipen.

review.commerce_description: Records only; no real payment, bank transfer, checkout or investment order.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.1 addresses reviewer sign-in feedback with a dedicated synthetic OpenAI review account using an independent credential. Reviewer access is supplied separately in the private Review details form. Existing user connections and MCP permissions are unchanged.
